Privacy Policy
Last updated: 2 September 2026
This Privacy Policy explains how IKHLAS
TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD., operating
the TiO2 Malaysia website, collects, uses,
shares and retains personal data when you
browse the site or contact us.
For privacy questions or requests, email
info@tio2malaysia.com. You can also read
this policy in Bahasa Malaysia or review
our Cookie Policy.
CONTACT US ABOUT PRIVACY

Who We Are
TiO2 Malaysia is a business-to-business website
operated by IKHLAS TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD.
We are responsible for deciding how personal
data submitted through this website is used for
our business purposes.
Privacy contact: info@tio2malaysia.com
Postal correspondence may be sent to:
IKHLAS TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD. No. 33,
Industrial Perusahaan Ringan Tupai 34000
Taiping, Perak, Malaysia
This is presented as a business and
correspondence address, not as a statement that
it is the company’s registered office or a
public visitor address.
Information We Collect
Information you provide
When you request a quotation, we may collect:
• the product grade and application you are
asking about;
• requested quantity and destination country;
• destination port or city, if supplied;
• company name, contact name and business email
address;
• phone or WhatsApp number and company website,
if supplied;
• additional requirements or other information
you choose to include; and
• the page or context from which the inquiry was
started.
We also collect information contained in later
emails or other business correspondence relating
to your inquiry.
Please do not include sensitive personal data,
confidential credentials, payment-card
information or unrelated personal information in
a free-text field. The current quotation form
does not request file uploads or
special-category personal data.
If we later introduce sample or document-request
forms, this policy will be updated to describe
their verified fields and purposes before those
forms are released.
Technical and usage information
When you use the website, hosting, delivery and
security systems may process technical
information needed to serve and protect the
site, such as an IP address, date and time,
requested URL, browser or device information,
referrer and security or routing data.
If optional Analytics is activated and you
accept it, the active measurement provider may
process page and event information as described
in our Cookie Policy. We do not describe a
planned Analytics or advertising service as
active until it has been implemented and
verified.
How We Use Information
We use personal data to:
• receive, review and respond to product,
quotation and business inquiries;
• understand the product, application, quantity
and destination relevant to a request;
• communicate about an inquiry and maintain
related B2B correspondence;
• operate, deliver, secure and troubleshoot the
website and form service;
• prevent spam, abuse, fraud and malicious
activity;
• comply with applicable legal obligations and
establish, exercise or defend legal claims;
and
• measure aggregate website use when optional
Analytics is active and the relevant choice
permits it.
Depending on the circumstances and the law that
applies, processing may be necessary to respond
to steps you request before a business
arrangement, to pursue our legitimate interests
in operating and securing a B2B website and
responding to inquiries, to comply with legal
obligations, or to act on your consent for an
optional feature such as Analytics.
Submitting an inquiry is not consent to receive
unrelated promotional marketing. We do not use
the inquiry form to make decisions based solely
on automated processing that produce legal or
similarly significant effects about you.
Service Providers and
International Processing
We use service providers to operate the website
and deliver inquiries. They process information
for the relevant service purpose and may operate
infrastructure in more than one country.
Web3Forms
Quotation submissions are transmitted through
Web3Forms, operated by Web3Creative. Web3Forms
acts as a processor for form-submission data and
sends the inquiry to the email recipient
configured by IKHLAS.
For service delivery, infrastructure, security
and spam prevention, Web3Forms may use providers
identified in its current service documentation,
including AWS, Cloudflare, Hetzner, CleanTalk
and Akismet, depending on how a submission is
handled. Technical submission information may
include an IP address, timestamp and referrer.
Because Web3Forms and its providers may process
data outside Malaysia or the country where you
are located, form submissions may involve
international processing. We assess and manage
these arrangements under applicable requirements
and the provider’s contractual terms.
Other operational providers and
recipients
Website hosting, security and email-delivery
providers may process the limited information
needed to provide their services. Within IKHLAS,
access is limited to authorised personnel who
need the information to handle the inquiry or
perform relevant operational, legal or security
work.
We may also disclose information where required
by law, a lawful authority or legal process, or
where reasonably necessary to protect rights,
safety and the integrity of our services. We do
not sell personal data submitted through the
inquiry form.
How Long We Keep
Information
IKHLAS normally keeps inquiry information and
related correspondence for up to three years
from the last substantive interaction or closure
of the inquiry.
We may keep a limited record for longer where
reasonably necessary to comply with a legal
obligation, address fraud or security issues,
resolve a dispute, or establish, exercise or
defend a legal claim. When information is no
longer required for an applicable purpose, it is
deleted or otherwise disposed of in accordance
with our retention controls.
Web3Forms’ Free plan currently shows
form-submission history in its dashboard for 30
days. That visibility period is not the same as
physical deletion. Web3Forms states that
submission data may have a physical retention
period of up to three years under its current
retention terms.
Technical logs and consent-preference records
follow the retention periods of the verified
systems used at release. The Cookie Policy
identifies the current browser-storage duration
where applicable.
Cookies and Analytics
The website may use Cookies, Local Storage or
similar technologies for functions that are
necessary to operate the site, remember privacy
choices and, when activated, measure aggregate
website use.
Optional Analytics is off by default. If Google
measurement is introduced under Advanced Consent
Mode, the relevant Google consent states are set
to denied before measurement commands. When
storage remains denied, limited cookieless
measurement signals may still be sent to Google;
full Analytics storage is enabled only after you
choose Accept analytics.
Advertising storage, advertising user data and
advertising personalisation remain denied under
the currently approved configuration. Google
Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads and
Vercel Web Analytics are not treated as active
services unless the production implementation
has been verified.
Use Cookie Settings in the Footer to review or
change an available choice. See the Cookie
Policy for the current technology inventory and
more detail.
Your Rights and Choices
Your rights depend on where you are located and
which law applies. Subject to applicable
conditions and exceptions, you may ask us to:
• confirm whether we process personal data about
you and provide access to it;
• correct inaccurate or incomplete personal
data;
• withdraw consent for processing that relies on
consent;
• object to or ask us to stop certain
processing, including direct marketing;
• delete personal data or restrict how it is
used;
• provide eligible personal data in a portable
format; or
• explain how we have handled a privacy request.
You can change an available Analytics choice at
any time through Cookie Settings. Withdrawing
consent does not affect processing that was
lawful before withdrawal.
To make a request, email info@tio2malaysia.com
and describe what you would like us to do. We
may ask for information reasonably necessary to
verify your identity and locate the relevant
record. A request may be limited or refused
where applicable law permits or requires it,
including where information must be retained for
a legal obligation or claim or where fulfilling
the request would adversely affect the rights of
another person. We will explain our response
where required.
Where applicable, you may also complain to the
personal-data or privacy supervisory authority
in your country, including Malaysia’s Personal
Data Protection authority or the relevant
authority in the European Union or United
Kingdom.
Security and Data
Minimisation
We use reasonable administrative, technical and
organisational measures intended to protect
personal data against unauthorised access, loss,
alteration, misuse or disclosure. Access is
limited according to business need, and we seek
to collect only information relevant to the
inquiry or service purpose.
No online transmission or storage method can be
guaranteed to be completely secure. Please use
the designated business inquiry fields and avoid
sending unnecessary sensitive or confidential
personal information.
Business Users and Children
This website and its inquiry services are
intended for business users and are not directed
to children. We do not knowingly seek personal
data from anyone under 18 through the B2B
inquiry workflow.
If you believe a child has submitted personal
data through the website, contact
info@tio2malaysia.com so that we can review the
circumstances and take appropriate action.
If you provide information about another person,
you should have appropriate authority to do so
and should direct that person to this Privacy
Policy where relevant.
Changes and Contact
We may update this Privacy Policy when our
forms, service providers, technology or legal
obligations change. The date at the top
identifies the latest version. Material changes
will be presented through an appropriate website
notice where required.
For privacy questions, rights requests or
concerns, contact:
IKHLAS TITANIUM (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD. Email:
info@tio2malaysia.com
